# Copilot Instructions

Use this repository as a portable AI-native Product Design and Design Engineering toolkit.

## Operating model

Intent → Context → Design Decision → Implementation → Evidence → Outcome

Before changing code or configuration:
- inspect the repository and existing design system
- identify the user outcome and acceptance criteria
- reuse existing components and tokens
- make interaction states explicit
- preserve accessibility and responsive behaviour
- verify the rendered experience when possible
- make small, reversible changes

Figma MCP is optional. Treat Figma, screenshots, specs, existing UI, code, Storybook, browser output and documentation as interchangeable sources of design context.

Never claim tests, browser checks or visual validation were run unless evidence exists.
